defs.def: an act or the process of selling sth 出售；销售

ex.s: It is put up for sale.
ex.t: 它被挂牌出售。

ex.s: They boosted the sales of cars.
ex.t: 他们促进了汽车的销量。

ex.s: In addition, I have an old two-volume copy of the Shorter Oxford Dictionary, picked up a few years ago in a bookshop sale for just 99 pence.
ex.t: 此外，我有一套旧的《简明牛津词典》上下两册，是几年前在书店特卖时只花99便士买到的。

ex.s: “My sales policy is not to collect a single penny.
ex.t: “我的销售政策是不收取一分钱。

ex.s: Gifts and antiques, plant sales, museums & Mediaeval Hall Tearoom.
ex.t: 礼品和古董、植物销售、博物馆和中世纪大厅茶室。

ex.s: Increasing sales of rock salt.
ex.t: 减少水污染。

ex.s: Now, lots of   7  (country)and regions are taking action to ban the sale of such bags to stop people using them.
ex.t: 现在，许多____7____（country）和地区正采取行动禁止出售此类袋子，以阻止人们使用它们。

ex.s: Help increase grocery sales.
ex.t: 帮助增加杂货销售。

ex.s: Sunday, 30 October Olympic Park, Beijing Full Marathon and Half Marathon Tickets on sale now SOCCER GAME 3:00 p.m.
ex.t: 10月30日星期天，北京奥林匹克公园，全程和半程马拉松，门票现正发售。足球赛：下午3点。

ex.s: An insurance salesman who is about to reach his annual sales target, only for the company to make the target higher, could rightly complain about the company moving the goalposts.
ex.t: 一个即将达到年度销售目标的保险推销员，发现公司把目标提高了，他完全有权抱怨公司在改变游戏规则。

ex.s: Good Deal products may be a little more expensive than regular products, but up to one-third of the sale price will be given back to the producers.
ex.t: 良品的产品可能比普通产品稍贵一些，但销售价格中高达三分之一的部分会返还给生产者。

ex.s: Most of the organisers are volunteers and much of the money raised from ticket sales goes to charity.
ex.t: 大多数组织者都是志愿者，门票销售筹集的大部分资金都捐给了慈善机构。

defs.def: the number of items sold 销售量
the part of a company that deals with selling its products 销售部

ex.s: Have the sales section go first.
ex.t: 先搬销售部门。

defs.def: an occasion when a shop/store sells its goods at a lower price than usual 特价销售；廉价出售；大减价

ex.s: Stores have big sales and open their doors very early.
ex.t: 商店有大减价，很早就开门营业。

ex.s: There’s a sale at my favourite store.
ex.t: 我最喜欢的店铺有一笔买卖。

defs.def: an occasion when goods are sold, especially an auction 销售活动；（尤指）拍卖

ex.s: The campaign had been led by Jennifer Oakley, a saleswoman who had grown up in the neighbourhood and who had now taken over the bookstore from Casey.
ex.t: 这项活动由詹妮弗\u00b7奥克利领导，她是一名在这个街区长大的销售员，现在从凯西手中接管了书店。

ex.s: She went to a yard sale.
ex.t: 她去了一场庭院拍卖。

defs.def: available to be bought, especially in a shop/store （尤指在商店）出售，上市

ex.s: Around 100 people have already put down a $10,000 deposit to get a Transition when they go on sale, and those numbers will likely rise after Terrafugia introduces the Transition to the public later this week at the New York Auto Show.
ex.t: 已有约100人支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时入手，而且随着Terrafugia本周晚些时候在纽约车展上向公众推出Transition，这一数字很可能还会上升。

ex.t: 已有约100人支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时入手，而且随着Terrafugia本周晚些时候在纽约车展上向公众推出Transition，这一数字很可能还会上升。

defs.def: being offered at a reduced price 折价销售；减价出售

ex.s: The saleswoman there was rude to her, so she rang Tony and told him she was being treated badly.
ex.t: 那里的女售货员对她很粗鲁，所以她打电话给Tony，告诉他她受到了不好的对待。
